title: Monotonicity of bounded walks
statement: Let $E$ be a relation on the natural numbers and let $n$ be a natural number. If $c$ reaches $t$ by a walk of length at most $j$ that uses only vertices less than $n$ (with a walk of length zero meaning $c=t$), then $c$ reaches $t$ by a walk of length at most $j+1$ under the same vertex restriction.
hypotheses_covered: There is an $E$-walk from $c$ to $t$ of length at most $j$, using only vertices less than $n$
